title: Nathan Twining reference in Disclosure Day, with the Twining memo and Majestic 12

tellings.quote: who's head of air material command 1947. He wrote the Twining memo. He was rumored Majestic 12 and 12 people are missing.

plain: A film called Disclosure Day, which Michels discusses in an episode about Steven Spielberg and Hollywood, nods to Nathan Twining, an Air Force general who in 1947 headed Air Materiel Command, the Army Air Forces' aircraft development and testing command. Twining signed the Twining memo, "AMC Opinion Concerning 'Flying Discs'," written on September 23, 1947, and Michels notes he was rumored to belong to Majestic 12, a supposed secret group of twelve officials handling UFO matters that is described in a set of disputed documents. Michels tells this himself, pointing to the line that "12 people are missing," as a hint that the film is drawing on real UFO history.
